name: Orbit — the gate sentinel
concept: An original floating sentinel orb held inside a lit orbital ring, with a calm two-eye-and-slight-smile face and a brushed metal badge plate mounted on the front of the ring: the orb is the agent that gets full production context, the ring is the boundary that decides what it can act on, and the badge on the ring is where the gateway's authority is stamped.
